description: Axis Desktop grants no Tauri permission to any web content. The window loads a remote Axis deployment over http(s), and Tauri only exposes native APIs to origins listed in a capability's `remote.urls`. Because this capability declares no `remote` block, the deployment the user signs in to has zero access to the native shell: it cannot reach the filesystem, the shell, the clipboard or any Tauri command. The opener plugin used to hand off-origin links to the system browser is called from Rust in src/lib.rs, not from JavaScript, so it needs no permission entry here.
